description: Scan a public website and grade how ready it is for AI search and AI agents, using the AgentReady standard. Returns the letter grade, Found-by-AI and Usable-by-AI scores, every check with its status and summary, and a link to the full report. Does not change the website.

url.description: Full public http or https URL to scan, such as https://example.com. A bare domain like example.com is accepted and scanned as https. Path, query, and hash are ignored. Private hosts and other schemes are rejected.

name: scan_website
title: Scan website
